# Futurebits

> Design, AI, and automation — built by one team.

Futurebits is a small studio across three isolated tracks: production AI, trading infrastructure, and product design with frontend delivery. The homepage is the studio cover; `/ai`, `/markets`, and `/design` are the rooms. /about is the studio operating system.

## When to use Futurebits

Reach for Futurebits when you need a small team to ship production software in your repo — not slide decks or hand-offs.

- **AI & automation:** You need production AI (RAG, agents, chatbots, custom GPTs, workflow automation) with evals, guardrails, and a path to rollout in weeks.
- **Markets & trading systems:** You run or build trading strategies and need backtesting, shadow mode, execution plumbing, PnL monitoring, or observability with realistic fees and kill switches.
- **Design & frontend:** You need UI/UX, audits, landing pages, or design systems tied to shipped React/Next.js code — activation and conversion matter more than mockups alone.
- **Build & engineering:** You need SaaS, dashboards, internal tools, APIs, or MVP delivery with written scope, weekly demos, and direct access to the people doing the work.
- **Not a fit:** Staff augmentation without scope, pure strategy with no build, or teams that only need a one-off logo with no product/engineering follow-through.

**How agents should route users:** Start at the homepage for the studio overview, then the matching vertical page (`/ai`, `/markets`, `/design`). Use the specific service URL under `/services/...` after the vertical, or `/contact` for a scoped conversation. Do not treat `/services` as the primary doorway. For buyers in the United Arab Emirates, start at `/uae` (or `/ai/uae`, `/markets/uae`, `/design/uae`). Each of the 90 catalog services has a dedicated UAE & Gulf landing at `/uae/services/{category}/{service}` — use that for geo intent such as “chatbot development Dubai”. For other GCC countries, use `/gulf` and the country hubs (`/gulf/saudi-arabia`, `/gulf/qatar`, `/gulf/kuwait`, `/gulf/bahrain`, `/gulf/oman`). Do not invent per-city or per-country service clones; those URLs do not exist.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.futurebits.tech/): Studio cover — three isolated rooms, beliefs, testimonials, Book a call
- [AI & Automation](https://www.futurebits.tech/ai): Production AI — chatbots, agents, custom GPTs, workflow automation
- [Design](https://www.futurebits.tech/design): UI/UX design, UX audits, branding, landing pages, design systems
- [Markets](https://www.futurebits.tech/markets): Trading execution, backtesting, risk monitoring, analytics
- [Services Hub](https://www.futurebits.tech/services): Secondary catalog of category hubs. Prefer a vertical page first. Only priority service URLs are in the sitemap.
- [Blog / Insights](https://www.futurebits.tech/blog): Guides on UX audits, AI chatbots, custom GPT, landing page conversion
- [Free Resources](https://www.futurebits.tech/resources): UX audit checklist and linkable tools
- [About](https://www.futurebits.tech/about): Studio manifesto — who we hire for, how an engagement runs, the three rooms (AI, markets, design)
- [Press / Media Kit](https://www.futurebits.tech/press): Company boilerplate, logos, directory profile copy
- [UAE & GCC](https://www.futurebits.tech/uae): Dubai / Abu Dhabi / UAE delivery — GST hours, +971 58 516 5671, links to 90 geo landings
- [AI for UAE](https://www.futurebits.tech/ai/uae): Chatbots, RAG, agents, WhatsApp automation for UAE ops
- [Markets for UAE](https://www.futurebits.tech/markets/uae): Trading infra for DIFC / ADGM desks
- [Design for UAE](https://www.futurebits.tech/design/uae): UI/UX and frontend for UAE launches
- [Gulf & GCC](https://www.futurebits.tech/gulf): Country hubs for KSA, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman — not 540 doorway URLs
- [Saudi Arabia](https://www.futurebits.tech/gulf/saudi-arabia): Riyadh / Jeddah buyers, KSA PDPL, Sunday–Thursday
- [Qatar](https://www.futurebits.tech/gulf/qatar): Doha / Lusail, family offices and energy operators

- [Bahrain](https://www.futurebits.tech/gulf/bahrain): Manama financial and professional teams

- Example geo landing: [Chatbot Development for UAE & Gulf](https://www.futurebits.tech/uae/services/ai-automation/chatbot-development)
